C144.notes: SER EU-NO-001. Obverse crowned Harald V monogram · legend 50 ØRE · NORGE · 1998 · crossed hammers · user shorthand 1998 + photo · Joseph: Here’s what I pick for 1500. Copper-toned Nordic odd-unit from the late 90s — café / kiosk / ferry change while the øre still jingled, fourteen years before the 50 øre was pulled from circulation in 2012. Country #21 — first Norway in the vault. Soft beat 1500 locks on this piece. Year-after sibling C268 / EU-NO-002 (2000 50 Øre · same KM#460 Nidhogg type). Norway flips now 2.
C144.story: A 1998 Norwegian 50-øre coin. One side shows King Harald V's crowned monogram; the other shows a dragon taken from the carved portal of the Urnes stave church, with the country name NORGE. Engraved by Grażyna Jolanta Lindau (initials GJL) and struck in bronze.
open_questions: The Phase 1 photo shows the animal/value side; the record calls the crowned monogram the obverse (side labels only). Confirm at Phase 2 (pro photos); the owner's pen label may be wrong.
